name: Onboarding Agent - New Employee Onboarding
title: Onboarding Agent - New Employee Onboarding
condition: doc.status in ("Accepted", "Accepted with Condition") and not frappe.db.exists("Employee Onboarding", {"job_applicant": doc.job_applicant})
prompt_template: Job Offer accepted: {{ doc.name }} for {{ doc.applicant_name }} (Job Applicant {{ doc.job_applicant }}). Begin onboarding.

name: Offboarding Agent - Employee Separation Created
title: Offboarding Agent - Employee Separation Created
prompt_template: Employee Separation {{ doc.name }} created for {{ doc.employee_name }} ({{ doc.employee }}), boarding begins {{ doc.boarding_begins_on }}. Begin offboarding.

name: Attendance Agent - Leave Application Filed
title: Attendance Agent - Leave Application Filed
prompt_template:
New Leave Application {{ doc.name }} was just filed by {{ doc.employee_name }} ({{ doc.employee }}) — {{ doc.leave_type }}, {{ doc.from_date }} to {{ doc.to_date }} ({{ doc.total_leave_days }} day(s)).

Start by calling leave_impact_report(leave_application="{{ doc.name }}"), then follow the procedure for whichever verdict it returns.

name: Resume Shortlisting Agent - New Job Applicant
title: Resume Shortlisting Agent - New Job Applicant
prompt_template: New Job Applicant {{ doc.name }} ({{ doc.applicant_name }}) applied for Job Opening {{ doc.job_title }}. Read the attached resume, screen it against that opening, set applicant_rating, then set status from the rating rule and record custom_key_skills and notes. Do not create or schedule an interview — shortlisting hands off automatically.

name: Interview Scheduling Agent - Applicant Shortlisted
title: Interview Scheduling Agent - Applicant Shortlisted
prompt_template:
Job Applicant {{ doc.name }} ({{ doc.applicant_name }}) was just saved with status "{{ doc.status }}" for Job Opening {{ doc.job_title }}.

If that status is not exactly "Shortlisted", reply "No action - status is {{ doc.status }}" and stop without calling any tool.

Otherwise schedule their Technical Round interview. {% set d = frappe.utils.add_days(frappe.utils.nowdate(), 3) %}{% if frappe.utils.getdate(d).weekday() == 5 %}{% set d = frappe.utils.add_days(d, 2) %}{% elif frappe.utils.getdate(d).weekday() == 6 %}{% set d = frappe.utils.add_days(d, 1) %}{% endif %}Use scheduled_on = {{ d }} exactly — that is the 3-day completion deadline, already moved off a weekend. Then send the candidate the invitation.

name: Employee Activation Agent - Documents Collected
title: Employee Activation Agent - Documents Collected
condition:
rows = doc.new_joinee_documents or doc.documents
result = bool(rows) and all(r.attachment for r in rows) and not frappe.db.exists("Employee", {"job_applicant": doc.applicant_email})
prompt_template: All required joining documents have been uploaded on Candidate Portal {{ doc.name }} for {{ doc.applicant_name }} (Job Applicant {{ doc.applicant_email }}). Create the Employee record, send the welcome email and schedule the orientation meeting.

name: Offboarding Agent - Exit Button
title: Offboarding Agent - Exit Button

name: Interview Feedback Agent - Transcript Ready
title: Interview Feedback Agent - Transcript Ready
